answer: Charge each new identity a refundable work bond and vest its voting weight only after a multi-epoch delay. A clone farm can whisper a burst of registrations, but those identities stay weightless until they keep posting unique, peer-attested answers through the vesting window. Any copied answer or shared parent graph starts a ripple that clustering can slash, burning the bond on every linked head. Honest influence therefore arrives only as a slow tide of passed challenges, so an attacker pays ongoing compute and capital per fake rather than a one-shot signup fee.
